name: next-commitlint
cmd: cp -a frozen-next/. .; set -euo pipefail; temp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$temp"' EXIT; printf '{"private":true}\n' > "$temp/package.json"; (cd "$temp" && bun add --dev @commitlint/cli @commitlint/config-conventional >/dev/null); printf "module.exports={extends:['@commitlint/config-conventional']};\n" > "$temp/commitlint.config.cjs"; failed=0; for file in integ-commits/*.txt; do echo "COMMITLINT $file"; "$temp/node_modules/.bin/commitlint" --cwd "$temp" < "$file" || failed=1; done; exit "$failed"
